contexts.text: I will destroy man () = that man would extinguish himself. Explained.

To destroy every substance which I have made from off the faces of the ground () = man's proprium, which is as it were blotted out when it is vivified... This is signified by its being destroyed, although it is never destroyed, but remains. Explained.
Every substance being destroyed that was upon the faces of the ground = that those were destroyed who were of the Most Ancient Church, and were of such a character.

Justification is not according to the common opinion that all evils and sins are wiped off and entirely blotted out when, as they suppose, they believe... Not the smallest evil which a man has thought and actually done in the life of the body is wiped off and completely blotted out, but everything remains. (See Abolish.) AC 2694:4. AC 5134, Explained.
Wilt thou destroy the righteous with the wicked? () = the Lord's grief... and intercession...
Jehovah's wanting to destroy the Israelites.
But with the Lord, evils and falsities were completely cast out and blotted out...
Thou shalt blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven () = that evil genii should have no communication whatever with those of the spiritual Church...

Blotting out I will blot out the memory of Amalek from under the heavens () = that this kind of falsity shall be entirely removed... To blot out the memory = to remove... For this kind of falsity can be removed, but not blotted out, as it still exists with the infernal genii...

If not, blot me out of Thy book which thou hast written () = that the Internal of the Word, of the Church, and of worship should not perish... To blot out from it = to perish, here not to perish, because it was replied, Him that hath sinned against Me I will blot out of My book. AC 10506.
To be blotted out of the book of Jehovah = not to appear in Heaven, thus to perish as to the spiritual life... Illustrated.
I will not blot out his name out of the book of life () = that he shall be saved. AE 199.
The Advent of the Lord is not to destroy...
To destroy the way of the paths () = that the truth which leads is not known.
